FLYW should remain in the underfollowed lane as an education-payment workflow and student-financial-software company, especially if SFS attach rates and enterprise education retention remain strong.

node: Student-loan servicing, education payments, and borrower communications systems
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the student-loan servicing, education-payments, and borrower-communications node. The strongest direct anchor is Nelnet because its disclosed segments explicitly include Loan Servicing and Systems plus Education Technology Services and Payments. The discovery lane includes Flywire for higher-ed payment workflow software, Maximus through Aidvantage federal loan servicing, and SLM as a credit-heavy but direct private student-loan originator/servicer. Pure lenders are included cautiously because the Serenity hypothesis seeks separable servicing/software economics rather than credit exposure.
